- Final full phase is all-pass519 units/156 browser cases. Earlier intermittent region and no-op helper failures are retained historically; the route/refresh/history race now has controlled delayed-route regressions. This is not an exhaustive defect guarantee.
- OAuth personal consent/session lifecycle and Stripe real sandbox verification remain blocked at the owner's request. Management-token verification401/zone403 and deployment/provider/operator gates remain independent. A source branch push does not deploy the repaired application.
